title: AI ko browser chalana sikhao
content:
Ye browser main nahi chala raha...
AI chala raha hai.
Open-source project Browser Use ne...
OpenAI ke Python SDK ke liye browser tools release kiye.
This is version 0.13.13, and it makes browser agents much easier to build.
18 default browser tools.
Navigate, click, type... sab ready.
Aapko har action khud code nahi karna padega.
Local browser ho ya cloud browser, dono chalenge.
So why does this matter?
Bahut saara kaam aaj bhi browser mein hota hai.
Prices compare karna, forms bharna, reports download karna...
data ek website se utha ke doosri mein daalna.
Most of this work has no API.
Aur jahan API nahi hai, wahan browser agent kaam aata hai.
Setup simple hai.
Step one... install the openai-tools extra.
Step two... OpenAI Python 3.31 ya usse naya version.
Step three... apna task plain English mein likho.
Jaise... "in teen websites pe price compare karo."
And the agent figures out the clicks.
Par limits bhi jaan lo.
Uploads, downloads aur Bash...
abhi SUPPORT nahi hain.
So if your workflow needs to download a file, this version won't do it yet.
Read the release notes before you build on it.
Builder tip.
Pehle ek boring repeat task choose karo.
Something you do every single week.
Wahi automate karo. Wahi asli value hai.
Fancy demo se zyada, ek ghanta roz bachana important hai.
Aur ek baat... agent ko pehle test data pe chalao, real accounts pe nahi.
Browser agents abhi early stage mein hain.
But they are getting better every month.
Jo aaj seekhega, wo kal clients ko ye bana ke dega.
Ek real example socho.
Ek online seller har subah teen competitor websites pe prices check karta hai.
That takes him almost an hour every day.
Ek browser agent ye kaam kar sakta hai aur ek simple sheet bana sakta hai.
Seller sirf final numbers dekhta hai aur decide karta hai.
Follow for daily AI, explained by a builder.
